# GLOSSARY

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| Project Truth | Machine-readable semantic, governance, evidence, and source facts used to produce and validate human-facing project state. |
| Immutable snapshot | A proposed SW2 execution unit in which all generators and validators consume the same candidate facts rather than rescanning independently. |
| Validation DAG | A proposed dependency graph that executes each required validation fact once per candidate snapshot and reuses proven prerequisites. |
| Machine evidence | Complete structural or acceptance data retained for verification even when a human-facing representation is simplified. |
| Human view | A bounded, semantic representation designed for comprehension without weakening the underlying machine evidence. |
